season_context.local_season_notes: Climate ranges from cold northern winters to mild Sun Belt states, so layering and transitional pieces matter. Retail calendar runs Thanksgiving, Black Friday and holiday party season through December, then winter clearance, resort/cruise drops, and SS27 deliveries from February.

sources.title: Who What Wear: Shopbop fall 2026 trends in and out
Who What Wear: NYFW SS27 trends

trends.name: Abstract animal prints
trends.summary: Retail buyers are steering past classic leopard toward tortoiseshell, irregular spots and terrain-like markings, ideally in small doses on bags or shoes; runway coverage also flags a broad leopard, cheetah and zebra comeback.

trends.name: Spiced hues replace quiet neutrals
trends.summary: Cinnamon, paprika and deep earthy shades are being sold as the new base neutrals for fall, ideally lifted with print, texture or embellishment.

trends.name: Wide, slouchy chinos
trends.summary: Basic khakis give way to chinos with wider legs and more volume, balanced with a fitted knit; Complex had also predicted upgraded khakis as a 2026 menswear staple.

trends.name: Bermuda shorts carried into fall
trends.summary: Longer tailored or skater-style Bermudas are styled with cardigans, blazers or light jackets as temperatures drop, rather than being packed away with summer.

trends.name: Modern bootcut and slouchy jeans
trends.summary: Denim is moving on from barrel shapes toward high-rise bootcuts, looser legs that pool slightly at the ankle, and a return of cropped lengths.

trends.name: Saturated and earth-wash denim
trends.summary: Jeans arrive in strong colours such as cherry red, ballet pink and cobalt, alongside sand, khaki and brown washes worn with knits and big-buckle belts.

trends.name: Slim power suiting and pinstripes
trends.summary: Sharper, narrower dark suits with pinstripes are replacing oversized borrowed-from-the-boys tailoring, citing Tom Ford, Gucci and Saint Laurent fall collections.

trends.name: Faux fur and statement shearling
trends.summary: Mink-like faux fur and dramatic, volume-heavy shearling coats from Gucci, Valentino, Saint Laurent and The Row are a key luxury outerwear story.

trends.name: Men's chore coats and shirt jackets
trends.summary: US menswear retailers told MR Magazine that chore coats and shirt jackets would be the go-to outerwear purchase for fall, with vests and reversible knits also strong.

trends.name: Men's suede and cashmere outerwear
trends.summary: Buyers for US specialty stores highlighted texture-led classics, especially suede and cashmere jackets and woven shirts, over trend-driven pieces.

trends.name: Suede, faux fur and velvet in street style
trends.summary: New York street style during September shows mixed suede and distressed leather jackets with faux fur, fringe and velvet under a broadly maximalist mood.

trends.name: Extreme-weather protective outerwear
trends.summary: Thick PVC trenches and other storm-ready pieces from Saint Laurent, Junya Watanabe and Loewe signal outerwear designed for harsher weather.

trends.name: Indie sleaze revival
trends.summary: A Y2K and 2010s party-girl attitude with rebellious styling resurfaced on fall runways at 7 For All Mankind, Valentino and Marc Jacobs.

trends.name: Rockstar slim fits over baggy
trends.summary: Complex predicted skinny trousers, fitted tees and leather biker jackets would challenge oversized streetwear in 2026, with slimmer Chelsea boots following.

trends.name: Bright camo and hockey jerseys
trends.summary: Colourful camouflage and reworked throwback hockey jerseys were tipped as streetwear revivals as consumers move away from earth tones.

trends.name: Kids: athleisure leads back to school
trends.summary: A Coresight survey found athleisure was the trend US parents were most excited about, ahead of collared tees, monochrome, preppy and bold prints; Nike and Adidas were the top brands.

trends.name: Kids: 90s nostalgia and sparkle shoes
trends.summary: A Maryland boutique reports girls buying 90s-inspired looks recognised from social media plus rhinestone and metallic footwear, while boys go for neon and playful graphics.

trends.name: Kids: soft, sensory-friendly basics
trends.summary: Parents are seeking tagless bamboo and cotton blends that wash well and resist pilling, partly for children with sensory sensitivities.

trends.name: Cobalt blue
trends.summary: Yves Klein-style cobalt was the standout NYFW SS27 colour at Ralph Lauren, Calvin Klein Collection, Kallmeyer and TWP, and was also prominent in show-goers' street style.

trends.name: Liquid satin and modern jacquard
trends.summary: Fluid satin takes over from stiff taffeta at Ralph Lauren and Sandy Liang, while jacquards appear in contemporary cuts at Proenza Schouler, Altuzarra and Tory Burch.

trends.name: Full midi skirts and romantic corsets
trends.summary: Voluminous midi skirts at Khaite and Brandon Maxwell, softer corsets with peplums and appliqué, and wavy crinoline hems were recurring shapes in New York.

trends.name: Small vintage florals and tiger stripes
trends.summary: Golden-toned, faded ditsy florals at Khaite, Altuzarra and Ralph Lauren sat alongside a wider adoption of tiger and feline stripes.

trends.name: Appliqué and tactile surfaces
trends.summary: Appliqué, feathers, fringe, puckering and woven textures added hand-worked depth at Diotima, Khaite, Michael Kors and Tory Burch.

trends.name: Daytime sequins and gold
trends.summary: Sequins and golden metallics were dressed down with basics such as Bermuda shorts, seen at Ralph Lauren, Cult Gaia and Altuzarra.

trends.name: Low-slung bumster waists
trends.summary: Very low-rise waistbands returned in New York at Ben Doctor and Ella Mae, in some looks revealing the top of the hips and lower back.

trends.name: Utility details replace bows
trends.summary: Girlish dressing turned functional at Sandy Liang and Collina Strada, swapping ribbons for cargo pockets and drawstrings, while Kai Cenat's Vivet debut fused tailoring with streetwear.
